verdict.rationale: Expensify offers 'Smart Limits on cards' and mentions bringing your own corporate cards, suggesting some card-level spend controls exist, but there is no evidence of restricting by specific merchant, or real-time point-of-sale auto-lock/decline enforcement for out-of-policy spend. Missing for 10: documentation of category/merchant-specific restriction rules, real-time point-of-sale decline mechanics, and any hands-on or independent confirmation that these controls actually block transactions at swipe time.
